1934, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 206 Cont.
July 24 Ann Nagle - 9 - Extremely nervous S .....
Mrs. Van ryckegylow - 38 - nervous breakdown.
Mrs. Florence M. Reno - 55 - operated on for Goiter Marcy 4th. Now poorly since june 15.
Mrs. M. Thea - 75 - suffering .. Shingles & Stomach ...
Nellie Webb ... 40 of Toledo - arthritis for about 12 yrs. Married out of Church (to Quaker) good man - honest conscient's sometimes to Church.
Baby Gerald Arpin - 16 mo. of Sandwich - has never tried to sit up or stand .. . .
Joseph Mouoseau - 56 - stroke - poison from ... teeth ...
31 Peter Mouoseau - 52 - cancer of throat - enrolled at 6:45 P.M. (5.00) Desrie Dezitter - 51 - cancer of intest's
Mrs. Van Loo - 44 - fears gall-stones Yapp - Mrs. Comm'n O.K.
Blank Page

Page 207 Page 208 Aug. 1 Thanksgiving - XI Davis in -Feb. one - 80 hopeless - next day after enrolled O.K.
Julia Brinke1 - 11 - operation on brain July 16 ... like sleeping sickness -Itch ....
John Sexton - 32 - U.D. Student - disapointed in "no position" given up Church- now seemingly against mother.
Matthew Theisen - 38 - Lost good position, "going mad" for plea- sure away from wife & family & Church.
Maurice Bazinet
5 Anna Finnigan - 29 - of Sarnia - doctoring for many years for Eyes : lost one 5 yrs. ago. Now threatened with loss of other. Is enrol- led Today 50c promises
